naturalOutputs: toReversed/with retain six returned elements per iteration. toSpliced retains each whole variable-length result array as one nested output element with normal ownership transfer. Receiver and inserted/replacement value construction, owned copying and output retention are timed; complete observation runs outside timing.
ownedSharing: Native copying independently clones descendants; JS copies references. Retaining borrowed native output elements requires owned clones, included in the complete iteration cost.
observer: Complete existing Gate56 TypeScript observer and concat Rust visitor; only operation naming changed. Native ABI/owner/field bindings remain pending real emission.

toSpliced.bounds: Signed start clamps. Omitted delete count removes the remainder; negative deletion clamps to zero.
